blurb: Guests can explore Victoria's waterfront by boat, enjoying views of architectural treasures and marine life. Tours include a 45-minute Victoria Harbour Tour and a Gorge Waterway Adventure through historic waterways and neighbourhoods. The ferry also connects waterfront destinations for locals and visitors.
